next.reason: 1985 GR10: 'The END-WRITE phrase delimits the scope of the WRITE statement' (Scope of Statements, IV-40). 2023 keeps optional END-WRITE in the WRITE general format (§2023:14.9.51.2) and states its effect for every explicit scope terminator in §2023:14.5.3.2: it terminates 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' and 'any unterminated statements that appear between'. Same.
